proof_body:
by
  intro G _ N hN hc x hx
  rw [Subgroup.mem_center_iff]
  intro g
  by_cases h1 : x = 1
  · simp [h1]
  have hconj : g * x * g⁻¹ ∈ N := hN.conj_mem x hx g
  have hne : g * x * g⁻¹ ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    apply h1
    have : x = g⁻¹ * (g * x * g⁻¹) * g := by group
    rw [this, h]; group
  obtain ⟨z, -, hz⟩ := (Nat.card_eq_two_iff' (1 : N)).1 hc
  have e1 : (⟨g * x * g⁻¹, hconj⟩ : N) = z := hz _ (fun h => hne (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have e2 : (⟨x, hx⟩ : N) = z := hz _ (fun h => h1 (congrArg Subtype.val h))
  have heq : g * x * g⁻¹ = x := congrArg Subtype.val (e1.trans e2.symm)
  calc g * x = g * x * g⁻¹ * g := by group
    _ = x * g := by rw [heq]
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (N : Subgroup G), N.Normal → Nat.card N = 2 → N ≤ Subgroup.center G
